title: Characterization and Computation of Feedback Nash Equilibria in Scalar Discounted N-Player Linear Quadratic Games
summary: This paper studies feedback Nash equilibria (FNE) in scalar discounted linear quadratic (LQ) games with $N$ players. By explicitly incorporating the discount factor, we show that finite-cost equilibria may fail to stabilize the original system, motivating a distinction between FNE and stable FNE together with a sufficient stability condition. Based on a parametric characterization of the policies, we propose numerical methods for computing all equilibria.
